gaps.sentence: The course offers not only theory ___ hands-on fieldwork.
gaps.explanation: 'Not only... but also' is the fixed correlative pair.

gaps.sentence: Insure the camera ___ it gets damaged in transit.
gaps.explanation: 'In case it gets damaged' = as a precaution against damage.

gaps.sentence: No sooner had the applause died ___ the encore began.
gaps.explanation: 'No sooner... than' is invariable; 'when' would be wrong here.

gaps.sentence: ___ most thrillers, the film reveals the killer in the opening scene.
gaps.explanation: 'Unlike + noun phrase' marks difference from a general category.

gaps.sentence: ___ the north coast is rocky, the southern beaches are soft golden sand.
gaps.explanation: 'While' can contrast two clauses in a single sentence.

gaps.sentence: He is far from lazy; ___, he trains six hours a day.
gaps.explanation: 'On the contrary' rejects the description and states the reverse, more strongly.

gaps.sentence: I'll tell you everything ___ you promise to keep it between us.
gaps.explanation: 'As long as' sets the condition attached to the promise.

gaps.sentence: Not only ___ the tickets cost more, but they sold out in minutes.
gaps.explanation: After fronted 'Not only', auxiliary inversion applies: Not only did the tickets cost more.
